newsitem.title: FINLAND: LEMMINKAINEN SEES UNCH FULL-YR PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LEMMINKAINEN SEES UNCH FULL-YR PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish construction company Lemminkainen Oy said in a statement on Friday its full-year 1996 result would be at the same level as last year.

"The Lemminkainen group's result is not expected to improve this financial year, but to remain at the level of last year and of the previous 12 months," the company said in its January-June report. Full-year 1996 net sales would increase slightly.
In 1995, Lemminkainen posted a 57.7 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax. The running 12-months to end-June result was also a 57.7 million markka profit, it said.
In 1995, group net sales were 2.99 billion markka.
Lemminkainen's first-half loss at 69.0 million markka was unchanged on the corresponding period one year ago.
